senses.en: to make an area more like a city

example.en: The government plans to urbanize the rural areas around the capital.
example.zh: 政府计划使首都周边的农村地区都市化。

senses.en: a toxin released when bacteria break down or die

example.en: Endotoxins from certain bacteria can trigger strong immune reactions.
example.zh: 某些细菌的内毒素可引发强烈的免疫反应。

senses.en: one of two approximately equal parts; a share or portion

example.en: Each heir received a moiety of the estate.
example.zh: 每位继承人得到了财产的一半。

senses.en: one of two divisions of a tribe in some societies

example.en: Marriage in the tribe often occurred between opposite moieties.
example.zh: 该部落通婚常发生在相异的半族之间。

senses.en: a tomb or burial chamber

example.en: Ancient sepulchres were carved into the rock face.
example.zh: 古墓开凿在岩壁上。

senses.en: calm satisfaction with oneself, sometimes with a hint of smugness

example.en: His complacence after one small success annoyed his teammates.
example.zh: 他一点小成功就自鸣得意，这让队友们很恼火。

senses.en: public notices or messages promoting products, services, events, or opportunities; plural of advertisement

example.en: The newspaper contained several advertisements for local jobs.
example.zh: 报纸上刊登了几则本地招聘广告。

senses.en: to dry something thoroughly, often to preserve it

example.en: The hot wind desiccated the crops in the fields.
example.zh: 热风使田里的庄稼干枯了。

senses.en: the legal right to control the copying and use of a creative work

example.en: The author holds the copyright to her novel.
example.zh: 这位作者拥有她小说的版权。

senses.en: to legally secure the copyright of a work
senses.zh: 取得…的版权；为…注册版权

example.en: She copyrighted the book before publishing it.
example.zh: 她在出版前为这本书注册了版权。

senses.en: to make a loud, harsh sound

example.en: The car horn blared in the traffic jam.
example.zh: 堵车时汽车喇叭发出刺耳的鸣响。

senses.en: a loud, harsh noise

example.en: We could hear the blare of trumpets from the parade.
example.zh: 我们能听到游行队伍传来的嘹亮的号角声。

senses.en: lacking intelligence or the ability to learn and understand quickly

example.en: She felt stupid when she could not answer the simple question.
example.zh: 她回答不出那个简单问题时觉得自己很笨。

senses.en: showing very poor judgment; foolish

example.en: Leaving the door unlocked was a stupid mistake.
example.zh: 没锁门是个愚蠢的错误。

senses.en: to take money out of a bank account or remove something

example.en: She withdrew some cash from the ATM.
example.zh: 她从自动取款机取了一些现金。

senses.en: to move back or leave a place, especially with troops

example.en: The troops withdrew from the area.
example.zh: 部队撤出了该地区。

senses.en: to stop taking part in something or formally take back an offer or support

example.en: She withdrew from the competition.
example.zh: 她退出了比赛。

senses.en: To give or share things among people or places.

example.en: Volunteers distributed food to families affected by the storm.
example.zh: 志愿者向受风暴影响的家庭分发食物。

senses.en: To spread or scatter something over an area.

example.en: The wind can distribute seeds over long distances.
example.zh: 风能把种子散播到很远的地方。

senses.en: To supply goods to shops or other businesses.

example.en: The company distributes its products to local stores.
example.zh: 这家公司把产品分销给当地商店。

senses.en: to experience something, especially a change or something difficult
senses.zh: 经历，遭受（尤指变化或困难）

example.en: The company underwent major changes last year.
example.zh: 公司去年经历了重大变化。

senses.en: to receive a medical procedure or treatment

example.en: She will undergo surgery next week.
example.zh: 她下周将接受手术。

senses.en: The process of teaching or learning the skills needed for a job or activity.

example.en: New staff receive two weeks of training.
example.zh: 新员工接受两周的培训。

senses.en: Physical exercise and practice to prepare for a sport or competition.

example.en: The players have training every morning.
example.zh: 队员们每天早上训练。

senses.en: a person who studies or works in science

example.en: The scientist collected water samples from the river.
example.zh: 这位科学家从河里采集了水样。

senses.en: the part of an object made to be held

example.en: The handle on the cup is broken.
example.zh: 杯子的把手坏了。

senses.en: to deal with or manage something

example.en: She handled the problem calmly.
example.zh: 她冷静地处理了这个问题。

senses.en: to hold or touch something with your hands

example.en: Wash your hands before you handle food.
example.zh: 接触食物前要洗手。

senses.en: being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else

example.en: Each snowflake has a unique shape.
example.zh: 每片雪花都有独特的形状。

senses.en: existing only in a particular place or situation

example.en: This bird is unique to the island.
example.zh: 这种鸟是该岛特有的。

senses.en: to state that something is especially important

example.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular practice.
example.zh: 老师强调了经常练习的重要性。

senses.en: to give extra force or weight to a word or point

example.en: She emphasized the word “now” to make her point clear.
example.zh: 她重读了“now”一词，以清楚表达自己的意思。

senses.en: the act of examining two or more things to see how they are similar or different

example.en: The report includes a comparison of the two designs.
example.zh: 这份报告包含对这两种设计的比较。

senses.en: a relationship based on similarities and differences
senses.zh: 相似或差异的关系；对比

example.en: The second option looks expensive by comparison.
example.zh: 相比之下，第二个选项显得昂贵。

senses.en: forming the base or most important part of something; essential
senses.zh: 基本的；根本的；至关重要的

example.en: Trust is fundamental to any healthy relationship.
example.zh: 信任对任何健康的关系都至关重要。

senses.en: a basic principle or rule that supports a subject or system

example.en: The course teaches the fundamentals of chemistry.
example.zh: 这门课程讲授化学的基础知识。

senses.en: a small room or cupboard where food and drinks are stored

example.en: She keeps canned goods and snacks in the pantry.
example.zh: 她把罐头食品和零食放在食品储藏室里。

senses.en: to invent or make up something untrue, especially a story or excuse

example.en: He fabricated an excuse for being late.
example.zh: 他为迟到编造了一个借口。

senses.en: to make or build something from parts or materials

example.en: The factory fabricates metal parts for cars.
example.zh: 这家工厂为汽车制造金属零件。

senses.en: a false belief held strongly despite clear evidence against it

example.en: He suffered from the delusion that people were following him.
example.zh: 他有一种人们正在跟踪他的妄想。

senses.en: a mistaken idea or opinion; something believed that is not true

example.en: It is a delusion to think money will solve all your problems.
example.zh: 认为钱能解决你所有问题是一种幻想。

senses.en: a small, smooth, rounded stone found on beaches or riverbeds

example.en: She picked up a smooth pebble and skipped it across the water.
example.zh: 她捡起一块光滑的鹅卵石，让它贴着水面打水漂。

senses.en: a vehicle that travels in space, carrying people or equipment

example.en: The spaceship will travel to Mars next year.
example.zh: 这艘宇宙飞船明年将飞往火星。

senses.en: a feeling that someone or something is worthless and deserving of no respect

example.en: She looked at the messy room with scorn.
example.zh: 她轻蔑地看着凌乱的房间。

senses.en: to treat someone or something as unworthy of respect; to reject with contempt

example.en: He scorned their offer of help.
example.zh: 他不屑接受他们提供的帮助。

senses.en: to refuse to do something because you think it is beneath you

example.en: She scorned to answer such a rude question.
example.zh: 她不屑回答如此无礼的问题。

senses.en: a person who owns or runs a small shop

example.en: The shopkeeper greeted every customer with a smile.
example.zh: 店主微笑着迎接每一位顾客。

senses.en: to shine with a flickering or sparkling light

example.en: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
example.zh: 星星在夜空中闪烁。

senses.en: a quick flash of light; a sparkle

example.en: There was a twinkle of humor in her eyes.
example.zh: 她的眼里闪着幽默的光。

senses.en: a common English surname; also a male given name
senses.zh: 罗宾逊（常见英文姓氏，也可作男子名）

example.en: Mr. Robinson is our new English teacher.
example.zh: 罗宾逊先生是我们的新英语老师。

senses.en: a small picture on a computer screen that represents a program, file or function

example.en: Click the icon to open the folder.
example.zh: 点击图标打开文件夹。

senses.en: a famous person or thing regarded as a symbol of something
senses.zh: 偶像；标志性人物（或事物）

example.en: She became a fashion icon in the 1990s.
example.zh: 她在20世纪90年代成为时尚偶像。

senses.en: a holy picture of a saint in some Christian churches

example.en: The church displays an icon of the saint.
example.zh: 教堂里陈列着一幅这位圣徒的圣像。

senses.en: full of bright sunlight

example.en: It was a sunny day, so we had a picnic in the park.
example.zh: 那天天气晴朗，所以我们在公园里野餐了。

senses.en: cheerful and happy

example.en: She has a sunny personality and always sees the bright side.
example.zh: 她性格开朗，总能看到好的一面。

senses.en: lasting for the whole of a person's life

example.en: They have been lifelong friends.
example.zh: 他们是毕生的挚友。

senses.en: the early part of the day, from dawn until noon

example.en: I always drink coffee in the morning.
example.zh: 我总是在早晨喝咖啡。

senses.en: the early period of something

example.en: He achieved fame in the morning of his career.
example.zh: 他在职业生涯的初期就获得了名气。

senses.en: a group of sports teams that compete against each other

example.en: Her team won the league last season.
example.zh: 她的球队上赛季赢得了联赛冠军。

senses.en: an association of people, organizations or states formed for a common purpose

example.en: Several nations formed a league to promote trade.
example.zh: 几个国家组成了联盟以促进贸易。

senses.en: not yet investigated or traveled through

example.en: Much of the cave system remains unexplored.
example.zh: 这个洞穴系统的大部分仍未被勘查。

senses.en: the science dealing with chemical processes in living organisms

example.en: She studied biochemistry at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习生物化学。

senses.en: an insect or other animal that carries pollen from one flower to another

example.en: Bees are important pollinators of many crops.
example.zh: 蜜蜂是许多农作物的重要传粉者。

senses.en: a bright green precious stone

example.en: She wore a ring set with an emerald.
example.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有祖母绿的戒指。

senses.en: bright green in colour

example.en: The valley was a rich emerald green after the rain.
example.zh: 雨后山谷呈现出浓郁的翠绿色。

senses.en: to twist the body about, especially from pain or struggle

example.en: He lay writhing in pain on the ground.
example.zh: 他躺在地上痛苦地翻滚。

senses.en: a period of isolation to prevent the spread of contagious disease

example.en: He stayed in quarantine for two weeks after exposure to the virus.
example.zh: 接触病毒后，他隔离了两周。

senses.en: to isolate a person or animal to prevent the spread of disease

example.en: The patient was quarantined at home.
example.zh: 病人被隔离在家中。

senses.en: slightly sticky, not fully dry

example.en: The paint still feels tacky.
example.zh: 油漆摸上去还是有点黏。

senses.en: showy and of poor taste

example.en: That shirt is a bit tacky for a wedding.
example.zh: 那件衬衫穿去婚礼有点俗气。

senses.en: energy, drive, and enthusiasm

example.en: The company thrived under the manager's dynamism.
example.zh: 公司在这位经理的干劲带动下蓬勃发展。

senses.en: a philosophical theory explaining phenomena by inner forces or energy

example.en: Leibniz is often associated with dynamism in philosophy.
example.zh: 莱布尼茨常与哲学中的力本说联系在一起。

senses.en: a small firework that makes a loud noise when it explodes

example.en: The children set off firecrackers during the celebration.
example.zh: 孩子们在庆祝时放鞭炮。

senses.en: a feeling that something desired may happen

example.en: There is still hope that the missing dog will be found.
example.zh: 仍然有希望找到那只走失的狗。

senses.en: to want something to happen and think it is possible

example.en: I hope you feel better soon.
example.zh: 我希望你早日好起来。

senses.en: a state in which there is no war or fighting
senses.zh: 和平；没有战争或战斗的状态

example.en: The two countries finally made peace after years of conflict.
example.zh: 经过多年冲突，两国终于实现了和平。

senses.en: a calm and quiet state, free from worry or noise
senses.zh: 平静；安宁；没有忧虑或噪音的状态

example.en: She enjoyed the peace of the early morning garden.
example.zh: 她享受着清晨花园里的宁静。

senses.en: a state of harmony and no disagreement between people
senses.zh: 和睦；人与人之间没有分歧的状态

example.en: They live together in peace.
example.zh: 他们和睦地生活在一起。

senses.en: an electric vehicle that carries passengers on rails along streets

example.en: We took the tram to the museum.
example.zh: 我们乘有轨电车去博物馆。

senses.en: a small cart used to carry coal or ore in a mine

example.en: The workers filled the tram with coal.
example.zh: 工人们把矿车装满了煤。

senses.en: the fact of being common or widespread in an area or group

example.en: The prevalence of smartphones has changed how people communicate.
example.zh: 智能手机的普及改变了人们的交流方式。

senses.en: (epidemiology) the proportion of people in a population who have a disease at a given time

example.en: The prevalence of diabetes increases with age.
example.zh: 糖尿病的患病率随年龄增长而上升。

senses.en: for an unlimited or unstated period of time

example.en: The meeting has been postponed indefinitely.
example.zh: 会议已被无限期推迟。

senses.en: in a way that has no clear or specified limit
senses.zh: 无明确界限地；无限度地

example.en: The coastline seemed to stretch indefinitely into the distance.
example.zh: 海岸线仿佛无边无际地伸向远方。

senses.en: to grab or hold something tightly

example.en: She clutched her bag tightly on the crowded bus.
example.zh: 在拥挤的公交车上，她紧紧抓着自己的包。

senses.en: a device in a vehicle that connects or disconnects the engine from the wheels

example.en: He pressed the clutch before shifting gears.
example.zh: 他换挡前先踩下了离合器。

senses.en: a tense, critical situation; also, a set of eggs laid by a bird at one time

example.en: She stayed calm in the clutch and won the game.
example.zh: 她在关键时刻保持冷静，赢得了比赛。

senses.en: done or used in a critical, decisive moment

example.en: He made a clutch shot in the final second.
example.zh: 他在最后一秒投进了关键一球。

senses.en: a deep, loud noise, such as an animal's call or an engine's sound

example.en: We heard the roar of the lion from across the zoo.
example.zh: 我们隔着动物园听到了狮子的吼声。

senses.en: to make a deep, loud noise like a lion or a powerful machine

example.en: The crowd roared when the team scored.
example.zh: 球队进球时，人群发出了震天的吼声。

senses.en: a large water bird with a long neck and webbed feet

example.en: A flock of geese flew south for the winter.
example.zh: 一群鹅飞往南方过冬。

senses.en: the meat of a goose eaten as food

example.en: We had roast goose for Christmas dinner.
example.zh: 我们圣诞节晚餐吃了烤鹅。

senses.en: to give something a sudden push or boost
senses.zh: 推动，刺激；突然加大（油门）

example.en: He goosed the accelerator to pass the truck.
example.zh: 他猛踩油门超过那辆卡车。

senses.en: (informal) a silly or foolish person

example.en: You forgot your keys again, you silly goose.
example.zh: 你又忘带钥匙了，真是个小傻瓜。

senses.en: to leave out; not include something

example.en: Please do not omit any important details from the report.
example.zh: 请不要遗漏报告中的任何重要细节。

senses.en: in a way done on purpose

example.en: He intentionally left the door unlocked.
example.zh: 他故意没锁门。

senses.en: relating to the side or moving sideways

example.en: The injury caused pain in the lateral part of the knee.
example.zh: 这个伤导致膝盖外侧疼痛。

senses.en: done or decided by only one side, without agreement from others

example.en: The company made a unilateral decision to change the schedule.
example.zh: 公司单方面决定更改时间表。

senses.en: affecting or involving only one side of the body
senses.zh: 单侧的；（医）仅影响身体一侧的

example.en: The patient reported unilateral hearing loss in the left ear.
example.zh: 病人反映左耳单侧听力下降。

senses.en: the period or activity of trying to win someone's love, usually before marriage

example.en: They had a courtship of two years before getting married.
example.zh: 他们在结婚前谈了两年恋爱。

senses.en: special behavior by animals to attract a mate

example.en: The peacock's display is part of its courtship.
example.zh: 孔雀开屏是它求偶行为的一部分。

senses.en: having the same or nearly the same meaning as another word or phrase; so closely associated with something that the two are seen as the same

example.en: In this region, the city's name is synonymous with the industry itself.
example.zh: 在这个地区，这座城市的名字几乎等同于这个行业本身。

senses.en: an estimate of how much something is worth

example.en: The bank ordered a valuation of the property before approving the loan.
example.zh: 银行在批准贷款前要求对这处房产进行估价。

senses.en: an assessment of the importance or value of something

example.en: Her valuation of the company's culture changed after working there.
example.zh: 在那里工作后，她对该公司文化的评价发生了变化。

senses.en: relating to or caused by earthquakes

example.en: Seismic activity was recorded near the volcano.
example.zh: 火山附近记录到了地震活动。

senses.en: very great or significant (figurative)

example.en: The decision had seismic consequences for the industry.
example.zh: 该决定对整个行业产生了巨大影响。

senses.en: to stick out from a surface or body

example.en: A nail protruded from the wooden board.
example.zh: 一颗钉子从木板里突了出来。

senses.en: a man of noble rank, such as a duke or baron
senses.zh: 贵族（男性），有爵位的男子

example.en: The nobleman owned vast estates in the countryside.
example.zh: 这位贵族在乡间拥有大片庄园。

senses.en: impressive and majestic, inspiring deep respect

example.en: The august halls of the university impressed the visitors.
example.zh: 大学庄严的大厅给访客留下了深刻印象。

senses.en: August: the eighth month of the year, between July and September

example.en: The festival takes place every August.
example.zh: 这个节日每年八月举行。

senses.en: acting quickly without thinking; hasty

example.en: It was impetuous of him to quit his job on the spot.
example.zh: 他当场辞职真是太冲动了。

senses.en: a transparent blue-green gemstone

example.en: She wore a ring set with an aquamarine.
example.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有海蓝宝石的戒指。

senses.en: a pale blue-green color

example.en: The sea was a beautiful shade of aquamarine.
example.zh: 大海呈现出美丽的海蓝色。

senses.en: easily excited or made emotional

example.en: The excitable puppy jumped at every sound.
example.zh: 这只易兴奋的小狗一有动静就跳起来。

senses.en: the state of having a bad reputation

example.en: The scandal brought the club into disrepute.
example.zh: 这一丑闻使该俱乐部名誉扫地。

senses.en: a person who installs and repairs water pipes and fixtures

example.en: We called a plumber to fix the leaking pipe.
example.zh: 我们叫了一位水管工来修理漏水的管子。

senses.en: the work of cleaning and managing a house or hotel rooms

example.en: Good housekeeping keeps the kitchen safe and tidy.
example.zh: 良好的家务管理能让厨房安全整洁。

senses.en: a child, especially one who is poor and badly behaved

example.en: A group of street urchins ran past laughing.
example.zh: 一群街头顽童笑着跑过。

senses.en: a small sea creature with a round spiny shell

example.en: Sea urchins cling to the rocks below the surface.
example.zh: 海胆附着在水面下的岩石上。

senses.en: the practice of arranging things in layers; wearing several layers of clothing

example.en: Layering is essential for staying warm in winter.
example.zh: 叠穿是冬季保暖的关键。

senses.en: things that cause a reaction in a person, animal, or organism

example.en: Bright lights and loud noises are strong stimuli for babies.
example.zh: 明亮的光线和巨大的声响是婴儿的强烈刺激物。

senses.en: things that encourage activity or growth

example.en: Lower interest rates acted as stimuli to investment.
example.zh: 较低的利率对投资起到了刺激作用。
